_readme: Game copy that is not in events/cities/items/dishes. Placeholders in {braces} are filled by the engine. Edit text, not keys.

ui.tagline:
Circumnavigate the planet
in 365 days.
Pack light. Come home.

daily.work: A work day. Meetings at odd hours, the laptop on a kitchen table.
daily.explore: You go out and get lost on purpose.
daily.rest: A slow day. Nowhere to be.

log.start: Day 1, {city}. One suitcase, one year, the whole planet. Pack.
log.packed: Packed: {weight} lb in the suitcase. {clothes} days of clean clothes.
log.bagLimit: The bag is at the limit. Your back has noted this.
log.travelHeavy: The suitcase fights you the whole way.
log.fiveContinents: Five continents. The passport is running out of pages.
log.homeAgain: Day {day}. {city} again. The same skyline, a different person under it.
log.suitcaseArrives: The suitcase arrives, apologetic and slightly damp.
log.wrongShoes: The trail was right there. You had the wrong shoes for it.
log.checkRoom: You check under the bed, behind the door, in the shower. Twice.
log.travelFatigue: Too many legs too fast; everything aches.

endings.hospital: Day {day}. {city}. A hospital bed with a view of a parking lot. The trail ends here; the story does not.
endings.flewhome: Day {day}. You book the flight home from {city} without telling anyone. {home} is nice this time of year.
endings.broke: Day {day}. The card declines in {city}. {home} has a couch.
endings.outofdays: Day 366. The year ends in {city}, {degrees} degrees of longitude from home. Next year, maybe.
endings.win: Day {day}. {home}. {cities} cities, {daysLeft} days to spare, {lost} things left in {roomWord} around the world. You circled it.

causes.hospitalWorn: Hospitalised in {city}, worn down by the road, day {day}
causes.flewhome: Flew home from {city} on day {day}, mood zero
causes.broke: Broke in {city} on day {day}, ${owed} in the hole
causes.outofdays: Ran out of days in {city}, {continents} of 5 continents

share.broke: CAUSE OF DEATH: THE CARD DECLINED
